tasks.title: Governed Source Adapter Registry
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Exactly the six frozen source families are registered through explicit adapter identity/version/media contracts with no format guessing or implicit proprietary decoder dependency.

tasks.title: Production Import Boundary
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Application accepts immutable source byte-identity envelopes through engine-neutral contracts and validates adapter/family/media identity before Canonical or metric projection.

tasks.title: Source Provenance Registry
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Source, stream, and artifact provenance persist exactly in existing DB 1.9 registry.data_source/source_stream/source_artifact relations with restart durability and immutable conflicts.

tasks.title: Governed Polars Compute Runtime
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Polars becomes an explicit frozen runtime dependency behind governed compute contracts; pandas is not a hidden default and business semantics remain engine-independent.

tasks.title: Parquet Data Plane
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Typed datasets use governed schema/partition/write/scan contracts over logical tpaa-parquet identities with artifact and logical-content hashes.

tasks.title: Real Job Lifecycle and Worker Commands
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Job lifecycle extends beyond SUBMITTED/CANCELLED and spawn workers execute governed serializable commands without inherited Qt or live DB connections.

tasks.title: Resource Safety Backpressure and Orphan Cleanup
tasks.minimum_acceptance: Bounded worker admission, cancellation/drain, timeout/failure handling, staging cleanup, and deterministic orphan recovery fail closed without deleting registered immutable products.

tasks.title: Production Import to Persistent Release Qualification
tasks.minimum_acceptance: A production-source import executes Worker -> Canonical -> World -> Metric -> Release -> durable storage with restart/replay parity under the unchanged exactly-14-job Hosted CI topology.
